name: noice
description: Plays a sound when your terminal task finishes. Toggle on/off from status bar.

noice.enabled.description: Enable sound notifications when terminal tasks finish

noice.onlyWhenUnfocused.description: Only play sounds when VS Code is NOT focused. Sound calls you back when you step away — silent while you watch.

noice.minDuration.description: Minimum seconds a command must run before playing sound

noice.volume.description: Sound volume (0 = silent, 1 = full). Independent of system volume.

noice.failureSound.description: Sound played when command fails (non-zero exit).

noice.showNotification.description: Show a notification message when command finishes

noice.dnd.enabled.description: Enable Do Not Disturb hours. Sound is silent during this window.

noice.dnd.start.description: DND start time (HH:MM, 24h). Mute at/after this time.

noice.dnd.end.description: DND end time (HH:MM, 24h). Resume sound at this time. Wraps midnight if earlier than start.
